fields.Name: T293 - Integrations Configure Connection Slide-In
fields.Description: Exercises the OpenEditPanel slide-in with its own name/status/credential editor (EditName/EditIsActive/EditCredentials) — a bespoke panel distinct from the generic entity form and the wizard.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, find and open the Integrations application, and open its 'Integrations' (Connections) section. On a connection card, click the 'Configure' button in the card footer. Verify a slide-in edit panel opens from the side titled 'Configure Integration' with a 'Connection Name' text field, a 'Status' Active/Inactive toggle, a 'Credential' section, and read-only Integration/Company fields, plus 'Save Changes' and 'Cancel' buttons. Click Cancel and confirm the panel closes without changes. Seeing the edit slide-in render and close is success — you do NOT need to save. If no connections exist, a clear empty state is acceptable. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: Clicking Configure opens a slide-in panel titled 'Configure Integration' with a Connection Name field and a Status toggle
The panel shows a Credential section and Save Changes / Cancel buttons
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
